## Expedia Group, Inc. (EXPE) `[Internet & Platforms]`
- EXPE rose 7.03% Thursday, October 15, 2026, according to the verified tape; MarketWatch reported a 6.25% gain to $291.87 and said the S&P 500 rose 0.33% and the Dow rose 1.08% in the same session (MarketWatch, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[1]
- Expedia’s October 15 advance followed three consecutive daily gains, with no single confirmed company announcement identified as the catalyst (MarketWatch, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[1]
- Expedia recently released its “Unpack ’27” travel-trends report and introduced Travel Audience Marketing, an advertising framework for reaching travelers before, during, and after booking (Quiver Quantitative, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[3]
- Expedia scheduled its third-quarter 2026 earnings report for November 4, 2026; the company’s latest quarterly materials cited double-digit growth in gross bookings and revenue (Quiver Quantitative, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[3]
- BTIG Research reiterated a “Buy” rating and set a $400 price target on October 6, 2026 (MarketBeat, updated Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[7]
- The latest analyst consensus was “Hold,” based on 18 Buy, 21 Hold, and 1 Sell ratings, with an average price target of $315.24 (MarketBeat, updated Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[4]
- Boyce & Associates Wealth Consulting acquired 21,813 EXPE shares worth approximately $5.75 million in the third quarter, according to its Form 13F filing (MarketBeat, updated Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[7]
- Expedia, Hotels.com, Vrbo, and Stayz faced reported scrutiny over a class-action lawsuit alleging that 15% hotel commissions contributed to higher room prices since 2020 (JKN News, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[5]
- A separate report said Expedia shares closed at $290.36, up 5.70%, and attributed the move to broader market and travel-sector trading rather than a confirmed corporate event (JKN News, Oct 15, 2026; publication time not shown).[5]
- No verified after-hours or pre-market Expedia catalyst or price move before the Friday, October 16, 2026, 02:03 ET cutoff was identified in the available results.
